description: The published LT+1125 screen about the Stage-1 (1125 K) fitted set, 0.9 e-folds, six temperatures, 240 replicates, common random numbers within each temperature. In this engine it has 17 directions (13 reactions and 4 sticking coefficients, terrace and step for AsH and MMGa): R3 covers engine IDs 3-5, each incorporation reaction R10-R15 is one direction (IDs 14, 17, 26, 20, 29, 23), and the surface-enhancement pair is gone.
